title.value: Better Modeling the Programming World with Code Concept Graphs-augmented Multi-modal Learning
title.justification: The paper discusses the use of code concept graphs and multi-modal learning to enhance modeling in software engineering.
title.quote: Better Modeling the Programming World with Code Concept Graphs-augmented Multi-modal Learning.

extractions.description: The paper investigates the enhancement of existing pretrained language models of code by integrating them with a graph neural network using concept graphs. The primary focus is on leveraging high-level relationships between domain concepts through multi-modal learning. Preliminary evaluations show an improvement in code search tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving code modeling through machine learning techniques and does not directly address climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Our vision articulates on the idea of leveraging multi-modal learning approaches to modeling the programming world.
